components.name: Accordion
components.purpose: Toggle progressive disclosure of related content.

components.name: Alert
components.purpose: Prominently inform users of an important status or change.

components.name: Avatar
components.purpose: Represent a user with an image, illustration or initial.

components.name: Badge
components.purpose: Show compact status, property or metadata near another element.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.purpose: Show current location in a navigational hierarchy.

components.name: Button
components.purpose: Trigger an action.

components.name: Button group
components.purpose: Group multiple related actions.

components.name: Card
components.purpose: Contain content representing one entity or task.

components.name: Carousel
components.purpose: Present multiple slides controlled by swipe, scroll or buttons.

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: Represent a binary choice or multiple selections in a group.

components.name: Color picker
components.purpose: Choose a color value.

components.name: Combobox
components.purpose: Select or enter a value while filtering available options.

components.name: Date input
components.purpose: Enter a date, often with separate day/month/year segments.

components.name: Datepicker
components.purpose: Choose a date through a calendar-based interface.

components.name: Drawer
components.purpose: Reveal a panel from an edge of the screen.

components.name: Dropdown menu
components.purpose: Expose actions or navigation choices from a trigger; not a form select.

components.name: Empty state
components.purpose: Explain that no data is available and offer recovery or next action.

components.name: Fieldset
components.purpose: Group semantically related form fields.

components.name: File
components.purpose: Represent an uploaded or downloadable file.

components.name: File upload
components.purpose: Allow a user to upload a file from their device.

components.name: Footer
components.purpose: Provide legal, copyright or related navigation at a page/section end.

components.name: Form
components.purpose: Group controls used to submit information.

components.name: Header
components.purpose: Provide persistent site/application identity and primary navigation.

components.name: Heading
components.purpose: Introduce a page or section with semantic hierarchy.

components.name: Hero
components.purpose: Lead a page with its primary proposition, visual and action.

components.name: Icon
components.purpose: Visually communicate the meaning or purpose of an interface element.

components.name: Image
components.purpose: Embed meaningful visual content.

components.name: Label
components.purpose: Provide a persistent textual label for a form control.

components.name: Link
components.purpose: Navigate to another resource or location.

components.name: List
components.purpose: Group related items in unordered, ordered or description form.

components.name: Modal
components.purpose: Interrupt the current flow with a focused interaction requiring resolution or dismissal.

components.name: Navigation
components.purpose: Group links used to move between pages or page sections.

components.name: Pagination
components.purpose: Navigate information split across multiple pages.

components.name: Popover
components.purpose: Show interactive floating content anchored to a trigger.

components.name: Progress bar
components.purpose: Show continuous completion status for a long-running process.

components.name: Progress indicator
components.purpose: Show progress through discrete steps.

components.name: Quote
components.purpose: Present attributed quotation or highlighted quoted content.

components.name: Radio button
components.purpose: Choose one option from a mutually exclusive set.

components.name: Rating
components.purpose: Display or collect a rating value.

components.name: Rich text editor
components.purpose: Edit formatted rich-text content.

components.name: Search input
components.purpose: Find content by entering a query.

components.name: Segmented control
components.purpose: Switch between closely related options or views.

components.name: Select
components.purpose: Choose one predefined value in a form.

components.name: Separator
components.purpose: Visually and semantically separate adjacent content groups.

components.name: Skeleton
components.purpose: Preview layout while content is loading.

components.name: Skip link
components.purpose: Let keyboard users bypass repeated content and jump to a page region.

components.name: Slider
components.purpose: Choose a value within a bounded numeric range.

components.name: Spinner
components.purpose: Indicate background work when completion progress is indeterminate.

components.name: Stack
components.purpose: Apply consistent spacing between grouped components.

components.name: Stepper
components.purpose: Increment or decrement a numeric value with controls.

components.name: Table
components.purpose: Display structured data in rows and columns, optionally with sorting/filtering.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: Switch among related panels within the same context.

components.name: Text input
components.purpose: Accept a single line of text.

components.name: Textarea
components.purpose: Edit multi-line text.

components.name: Toast
components.purpose: Show transient layered feedback without blocking the current task.

components.name: Toggle
components.purpose: Switch a setting between two states.

components.name: Tooltip
components.purpose: Show brief descriptive information for an element, usually on hover/focus.

components.name: Tree view
components.purpose: Display nested hierarchical information.

components.name: Video
components.purpose: Present video with appropriate playback controls.

components.name: Visually hidden
components.purpose: Provide assistive-technology context without visible presentation.
